problem_evidence: SQLite integrity and quick checks pass, but PRAGMA foreign_keys is off by default and only six foreign-key definitions exist.
The database has zero CHECK constraints, zero triggers, only five explicit indexes, and PRAGMA user_version is zero.
Claims have one source pointer and no normalized assertion/evidence model; no evidence table exists.
Node type, edge type, status, and source type are free text; 239 distinct node status values and 118 active edge types exist.
Known views include superseded claim/edge rows, so current-state retrieval is not authoritative.
FTS is currently synchronized by content, but no database triggers enforce future synchronization.

Three normalized alias collision groups, six normalized duplicate-node candidate groups, and eight open P0/P1 validations without due dates require explicit handling; none may be silently merged or assigned fabricated dates.

authoritative_model.assertion: a new atomic assertion layer becomes the authority for statements, canonical facts, literal values, and entity-object relationships.

authoritative_model.evidence: evidence_item plus assertion_evidence support multiple supporting or contradicting evidence items with exact source locations.

authoritative_model.routing: canonical_route becomes the one authoritative route; existing route columns/tables become validated derivatives or compatibility interfaces.
authoritative_model.search: an approved search_document projection feeds an external-content FTS5 index with synchronization triggers and leakage tests.
authoritative_model.source: source remains the source registry and gains deterministic fingerprint/version controls.

selected_design.compatibility_strategy: do not delete legacy tables during migration; expose compatibility views and validate row/hash parity before authority changes
selected_design.id_strategy: preserve all existing IDs; generate new IDs deterministically from namespace, stable natural key, source fingerprint, and versioned algorithm
selected_design.identity_strategy: deterministic match first; probabilistic matches create candidates only; merge/split is audited and reversible
selected_design.migration_pattern: additive-first shadow tables, deterministic backfill, validation, compatibility views, controlled authority cutover, and reversible rollback/forward repair
selected_design.temporal_strategy: bitemporal valid-time and transaction-time fields with precision/estimated/unknown flags; current and historical views are separate
selected_design.transaction_strategy: BEGIN IMMEDIATE for canonical promotion; deferred reads; all multi-table writes include audit and rollback as one transaction
